    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AmbientLight
    Represents ambient lighting in the scene.
    Blackboard
    The Blackboard class represents a 2D target area for multiple sampling (super-sampling).
    Blackboard.Builder
    Builder class for Blackboard.
    Camera
    Camera class representing a point of view in the 3D scene.
    Camera.Builder
    Builder class for creating Camera objects using the Builder pattern.
    Color
    Wrapper and extension of Color.
    CustomPictureTest
    Test class for rendering a custom 3D scene showcasing all engine capabilities: Shadows, Reflections, Refractions, and Partial Shadows.
    Cylinder
    Represents a finite cylinder in 3D space.
    DirectionalLight
    Represents a directional light source (e.g., the sun).
    Double3
    Immutable container for three double values.
    Geometries
    Composite class representing a collection of geometries.
    Geometry
    Interface Geometry is the basic interface for all geometric objects in the 3D space.
    Intersectable
    Interface-like abstract class representing geometries that can be intersected by a ray.
    Intersectable.Intersection
    Passive Data Structure representing an intersection point with its specific geometry.
    LightSource
    Interface for external light sources in a scene.
    Main
    Basic sanity tests for the primitives classes.
    Material
    Passive Data Structure (PDS) representing the material properties of a geometry.
    Plane
    Class Plane represents a plane in 3D space.
    Point
    Class Point is the basic object representing a point with 3 coordinates in the 3D space.
    PointLight
    Represents a point light source (e.g., a light bulb).
    Polygon
    Represents a convex polygon in a 3D Cartesian coordinate system.
    RadialGeometry
    Abstract class RadialGeometry is the base class for all geometric objects that have a radius.
    Ray
    Class Ray represents a semi-line in 3D space.
    RayTracerType
    Enumerates the available ray tracing strategies.
    Scene
    Represents a scene to be rendered.
    SceneXmlParser
    Parses an XML file to construct a Scene object.
    Sphere
    Class Sphere represents a sphere in 3D space.
    SpotLight
    Represents a spot light source (e.g., a flashlight).
    Triangle
    Class Triangle represents a triangle in 3D space.
    Tube
    Class Tube represents an infinite tube in 3D space, defined by a radius and an axis ray.
    Util
    Collection of low-level utility methods used throughout the primitives package.
    Vector
    Class Vector represents a direction and magnitude in 3D space.
